rubrics.justification: Generally identifies a blastocyst with good expansion and uncertain ICM/TE quality, but likely overcalls expansion/hatching status; image is more consistent with an expanded blastocyst with indistinct ICM and somewhat sparse/irregular TE rather than clearly grade 5 or hatching.

Integrates age, BMI, PCOS, ovarian response, sperm quality, endometrium, and first-cycle status well with embryo prognosis, though some statements about PCOS and aneuploidy/oocyte quality are somewhat overstated.

Reasoning is structured and mostly consistent, linking morphology and favorable patient factors to prognosis; minor issues include a somewhat optimistic implantation estimate for a non-euploid, morphologically average blastocyst and uncertainty in grading.

Mostly consistent with standard IVF practice (SET in a young patient, cautious use of PGT-A after failures), but recommending/considering assisted hatching based on this image is not strongly guideline-supported, and ERA/immunologic testing suggestions are weakly evidence-based.

Provides practical next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support review, cryopreservation, and reassessment after failure; recommendations are useful though some are generic and a few are not strongly evidence-based.
